**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:2974)

**Proposed mechanism:** DNM2 (HGNC:2974) —DISRUPTS→ Endocytosis (GO:0006898); Endocytosis (GO:0006898) —LEADS_TO→ Myopathy (HP:0003198); Endocytosis (GO:0006898) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital myopathy (HP:0003198); Endocytosis (GO:0006898) —LEADS_TO→ Centronuclear myopathy (HP:0003198). Mutations in DNM2 disrupt the process of endocytosis, which is crucial for cellular membrane trafficking and function. Impaired endocytosis in muscle cells leads to the development of myopathies, including congenital myopathy and centronuclear myopathy.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of a pathogenic variant in DNM2 with a minor allele frequency greater than 1% in gnomAD. _(variant: HGNC:2974)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of DNM2 in these myopathies could lead to therapeutic strategies targeting endocytosis or dynamin function for both conditions.

#### 6. autoinflammation-PLCG2-associated antibody deficiency-immune dysregulation  —  Tier 3 — Moderate / Emerging  (fitness 0.333)
**Link type:** shared pathway (Reactome:R-HSA-166016)

**Proposed mechanism:** DNM2 (HGNC:2828) —DISRUPTS→ Endocytosis and cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0006898); Endocytosis and cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0006898) —DECREASES→ Cytosolic calcium homeostasis (GO:0005884); PLCG2 (HGNC:9130) —DISRUPTS→ B cell signaling (WP408); B cell signaling (WP408) —INCREASES→ Cytosolic calcium homeostasis (GO:0005884); Cytosolic calcium homeostasis (GO:0005884) —LEADS_TO→ Immune dysregulation (HP:0002715); Cytosolic calcium homeostasis (GO:0005884) —LEADS_TO→ Autoinflammation (HP:0011570); Cytosolic calcium homeostasis (GO:0005884) —LEADS_TO→ Antibody deficiency (HP:0002723). DNM2 haploinsufficiency impairs endocytosis and cytoskeletal dynamics, indirectly leading to dysregulated cytosolic calcium homeostasis. **How to falsify it:** Demonstration that mutations in DNM2 do not affect cytosolic calcium levels or that PLCG2 mutations do not impact endocytosis or cytoskeletal dynamics in immune cells would falsify this hypothesis. Furthermore, identifying a specific variant in DNM2 or PLCG2 with a frequency >1% in gnomAD would challenge its pathogenicity and thus the proposed mechanism. _(variant: rs141033145)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding this mechanistic link could reveal novel therapeutic targets for both diseases. Modulating cytosolic calcium homeostasis or downstream signaling pathways could offer a unified treatment strategy for patients with these distinct, yet mechanistically related, immune disorders.
